translationRepairs: On xinyou day Pillar-of-State Yuwen Chun, Duke of Qi; Yu Shi, Duke of Yan; and Helan Fu'en, Duke of Gao were all made superior pillars-of-state.
On xinyou day Pillar-of-State Yuwen Chun, Duke of Qi; Yu Shi, Duke of Yan; and Heba Fu'en, Duke of Gao were all made superior pillars-of-state.
s0018 names 郜國公賀拔伏恩; 賀拔 is the surname Heba, not Helan (賀蘭), so Heba Fu'en is the accurate English rendering.
Yang Yong'an, Man leader of Sha Province and Kai Fu, gathered troops in response to Wang Qian; Grand General Daxi Ru, Duke of Le'ning, was sent to suppress him.
Yang Yong'an, Di leader of Sha Province and Kai Fu, gathered troops in response to Wang Qian; Grand General Daxi Ru, Duke of Le'ning, was sent to suppress him.
s0063 has 沙州氐帥; 氐 is the Di people, not 蠻 Man, so Di leader correctly restores the ethnic designation.
The six provincial inspector-generals of Xiang, Qing, Jing, Jin, Jin, and Liang were abolished.
The six provincial inspector-generals of Xiang, Qing, Jing, the two Jin prefectures, and Liang were abolished.
s0066 lists distinct provinces 金 and 晉, both romanized Jin; referring to them as the two Jin prefectures distinguishes them naturally without inserting Chinese characters into the English text.

On renshen day General Yang Yong, Duke of Changning, was made superior pillar-of-state and grand marshal; Junior Steward of Tombs Yuan Xiaoju, Duke of Shiping West, was made grand minister of justice.
On renshen day General Yang Yong, Duke of Changning, was made superior pillar-of-state and grand marshal; Junior Steward of Tombs Yuan Xiaoju, Duke of Shiping, was made grand minister of justice.
Chapter s0114 reads 始平西元孝矩, but Wikisource Zhou Shu juan 8 has 始平公元孝矩; Yuan Xiaoju's title is Duke of Shiping, and Shiping West is unsupported.
